// Moore FSM, positive edge triggered reset, inline state encoding
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  in,
    output reg out
);
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin next_state = 2'b00; out = 1'b0; end
            2'b01: begin next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; out = 1'b0; end
            2'b10: begin next_state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b01; out = 1'b0; end
            2'b11: begin next_state = in ? 2'b00 : 2'b10; out = 1'b1; end
        endcase
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
endmodule

module TopModule(input  clk, input  areset, input  in, output reg out);
  reg [1:0] state, next_state;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
    else state <= next_state;
  end
  always @(*) begin
    case (state)
      2'b00: begin out <= 1'b0; next_state = (in) ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; end
      2'b01: begin out <= 1'b0; next_state = (in) ? 2'b10 : 2'b01; end
      2'b10: begin out <= 1'b1; next_state = (in) ? 2'b11 : 2'b00; end
      2'b11: begin out <= 1'b0; next_state = (in) ? 2'b10 : 2'b01; end
    endcase
  end
endmodule
